name: Cisco AI Defense skill-scanner
author: Cisco AI Defense

amendments.append: Intake also runs a pinned static skill scanner over the fetched files, for example `cisco-ai-skill-scanner==2.3.2`, and keeps its SARIF with the review. Its LLM judge is off or uses a local model: skill text under review never goes to a hosted model or vendor cloud (AGT-4).

notes: GitHub licence detection reports NOASSERTION; LICENSE is the Apache-2.0 short notice (© Cisco Systems). The vendor says detection without the LLM judge is low, so the scanner adds to the consume.mjs heuristics and the agent's own review; it doesn't replace them.
rationale: Distilled into AGT-5's intake step. It is the most complete open skill scanner (signatures, dataflow, SARIF, CI workflow) and is Apache-2.0 with active releases. Snyk agent-scan was rejected for this role because it requires a Snyk token and sends configs to Snyk's API. NVIDIA SkillSpector is queued and not yet scored, so this choice is to be re-compared when it is.
